own: Get with design and come up with a creative solution that is both explanatory to the ad poster and obvious at the same time. It shouldn't need a lot of reading; it should be very obvious and still aesthetically pleasing and make sense. Just tell them that we can't get a read on the currency they're choosing for that ad, so therefore that ad can't go live. Or, if it's an ad that has a dropdown with multiple currencies, then the one currency is not going to be displayed, or it'll be displayed saying "not available" or something like that. Get with design for the creativity.
question: "My offers" is the vendor's list of their own ads. Should an ad there be flagged when one of its currencies has no market price?
